function REMOVE-INCONSISTENT-
    VALUES(Xi, Xj)
  removed ← false
  for each x in DOMAIN[Xi] do
    if no value y in DOMAIN[Xj]
       allows (x, y) to satisfy
       the constraint Xi ↔ Xj
      then delete x from
             DOMAIN[Xi]
           removed ← true
  return removed
